commandId.description: The client-generated UUID every command takes; a retry with the same id applies once.

connectionId.description: A key-manager connection's id: a version 4 UUID the adding client mints, kept in lowercase.

kind.description: What holds a stored value Move can take: forge-account (a forge account's pasted token).

id.description: The item's id with its owner: a forge account's id.

item.description: The item whose stored value is answered: one a Move answered cannot_write on the connection.
